description: This file defines the NowPlayingBar custom UI component for an Android music player app. It manages binding to a MusicService, updates UI based on the current song and playback state, and handles user interactions such as clicking to open the PlayerActivity or toggling playback.

classes.name: NowPlayingBar
classes.description: A custom LinearLayout view that displays the currently playing song’s album art and title, with controls to play/pause music and navigate to the full player screen. It binds to a MusicService and observes its LiveData for updates.

methods.name: <constructor>
methods.description: Initializes the view, inflates layout, binds UI elements, sets click listeners, and binds to MusicService.

methods.name: setupObservers
methods.description: Sets up observers for LiveData in MusicService to update UI when current song or playing state changes.

methods.name: onDetachedFromWindow
methods.description: Unbinds from the MusicService when the view is detached to prevent leaks.
